title: Mohican Adventure Go-Karts
specs: Indoor swimming pool and hot tub at campground
Lake and pond stocked for fishing with no permit required
Aerial high ropes course with multiple difficulty levels
Participants under 16 must have adult supervision; 1 adult per 2 children actively monitoring in aerial park
Weight and harness fit required for aerial park participation
Children 10 and under must wear life jackets and be in rafts for river trips; no tube rentals for children
Must be at least 18 to reserve a campsite, 21 to reserve a cabin
Group rates available for 12+ people on river trips and packages, excluding Saturdays and holiday Sundays in season

blurb: Guests can camp in tents, RVs, or cabins with amenities including shower houses, fishing, and playgrounds. The adventure center offers river trips, go-karts, mini-golf, and an aerial high ropes course. Group packages and discounts are available, and reservations are required for cabins and camping sites.
extraNote: Go-Karts do not operate during thunder, lightning, or rain; Slick Track closed in rain · Aerial Park closed during thunder, lightning, or strong winds; rain checks available under conditions · River trips have last due in times; late returns incur $30 per boat fee · Reservations required 48 hours in advance for camping and cabins; paid in full at booking · Visitors not permitted; all guests must be pre-registered · Quiet time 11pm to 7am; no loud noise · Canoe Livery and Fun Center at 3045 State Route 3 South, Loudonville, Ohio 44842 · April 1 through October 31
